summary: Virtual Cards Color Selection and Refund System testing completed. Backend: 15/15 tests passed. Frontend: All UI flows working correctly. Virtual cards support 8 color themes. Refund system includes: eligibility check (48h window), auto-refund for amounts < 50000 XOF, 6 predefined reasons, user can view/cancel requests.

backend_virtual_cards_colors: GET /api/virtual-card/colors - Returns 8 color options (blue, red, green, purple, orange, black, gold, teal)
POST /api/virtual-card/create - Creates card with selected color (or returns limit error for unverified users)
POST /api/virtual-card/create - Creates card with custom name
POST /api/virtual-card/create - Invalid color defaults to blue
backend_refund_reasons: GET /api/refunds/reasons - Returns 6 predefined reasons with auto_eligible flags
backend_refund_eligibility: GET /api/refunds/eligibility/{id} - Returns eligibility info with time_remaining and auto_refund_eligible
backend_refund_requests: GET /api/refunds/my-requests - Returns user's refund requests list
POST /api/refunds/request - Auto-approves eligible requests (amount < 50000 XOF + auto_eligible reason)
backend_history_integration: GET /api/transactions - Returns transactions with type, amount, status, created_at
GET /api/refunds/my-requests - Returns refund requests for history page
frontend_virtual_cards_page: Page loads at /virtual-cards with title 'Cartes Virtuelles'
Existing card displayed with custom name 'Ma Carte Shopping'
Create card dialog opens with 'Nouvelle carte' button
8 color selection buttons visible (Bleu, Rouge, Vert, Violet, Orange, Noir, Or, Turquoise)
Currency selection dropdown (XOF, EUR, USD, GBP, MAD)
frontend_history_page: Page loads at /history with title 'Historique des transactions'
Transactions tab shows list with type badges (Remboursement, Envoyé, Complété, Remboursé)
Refund button appears on eligible outgoing transfers
Remboursements tab shows refund requests with status (En cours, Auto badge)
frontend_refund_dialog: Shows auto-refund indicator when eligible ('Remboursement automatique disponible')

critical_code_review_comments: Virtual cards color feature well implemented with 8 color options
Refund system properly checks 48h eligibility window
Auto-refund logic correctly implemented (amount < 50000 XOF + auto_eligible reason)
History page tabs properly separate transactions and refund requests
Refund dialog shows all required information (time remaining, auto-refund eligibility, reasons)
